issue: Filter criteria cannot be defined, so filter correctness cannot hold
actual: No filtering UI exists anywhere in the app (no filter controls in headers, toolbar, sort menu, or fields dialog), so there are no active criteria to include/exclude entries by and no filters to clear.

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values instead of displayed values
actual: Entry "Zebra QA task" displays "Mar 5, 2026" and Completed "Yes", but searching "Mar 5" returns "0 entries matching \"Mar 5\"" and searching "Yes" returns "0 entries matching \"Yes\"". Searching the internal raw values works instead: "2026-03-05" returns 1 entry and "true" returns 3 entries (Review marketing materials, Zebra QA task, Team sync meeting notes).

evidence: Query "MARKET" (uppercase) matched "Review marketing materials" and the footer showed "1 entry matching \"MARKET\""; clearing the box restored all 6 rows with footer "6 entries" and the manual order intact.
